_description: Four frames: two valid, two degenerate. The two degenerate items carry a timestamp and asset_id but all sensor values are fault strings (non-numeric). The normalizer raises invalid_signal_values per degenerate item, causing those items to fail schema validation before ingest. The two valid items proceed.
_expected: HTTP 422 with per-item validation errors for items 3 and 4, OR HTTP 200 partial_success if SII accepts degenerate frames. Actual outcome should be captured during replay.
_operator_note: For a guaranteed partial_success outcome use partial_success.csv via POST /ingest/csv instead. The batch JSON path validates all items at request time; any item failing normalization may cause the entire batch to be rejected (422). The CSV path validates row-by-row and always returns partial_success for mixed files.
